units: <cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 3:4">Ab. Zar. III, 4</cite> <he>מרחץ של א׳</he> a bath where A. has a statue.
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 3:4">Ib.</cite> we do not say, the bath has been built <he>נוי לא׳ וכ׳</he> as an ornament of A., but we say, A. is an ornamental attachment to the bath.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 8:8:8">Y. Shebi. VIII, end 38ᵇ</cite> <he>מזלפין להדא א׳</he> squirting water (as a libation) to A.
